description.zh: 滚动时不同图层以不同速度移动——背景慢、前景快—— 用速度差制造纵深。 是"2D 里伪造 3D"最便宜的手段， 常见于首屏大图与滚动叙事页面。
description.en: On scroll, layers move at different speeds — background slower, foreground faster — and the velocity gap reads as depth. The cheapest way to fake 3D in 2D; a staple of hero sections and scrollytelling.

use_when.zh: 首屏大图或插画需要纵深与电影感
use_when.en: Hero imagery that needs depth and a cinematic feel

use_when.zh: 滚动叙事页面，图层分段讲述
use_when.en: Scrollytelling where layers stage the story

use_when.zh: 装饰性背景纹理缓慢移动

avoid_when.zh: 长文阅读页面（滚动与文字错位致晕）
avoid_when.en: Long-form reading — offset motion causes nausea

avoid_when.zh: 移动端大规模视差（性能差且眩晕）
avoid_when.en: Heavy parallax on mobile — jank and motion sickness

avoid_when.zh: 视差影响可读性或遮挡操作目标
avoid_when.en: When it harms legibility or blocks targets

note.zh: 背景以 0.3～0.5 倍速滚动，最常用
三层以上不同速率，纵深更强
note.en: Three-plus layers at different rates — deeper feel

note.zh: animation-timeline: scroll() 绑定滚动进度
note.en: animation-timeline scroll() binds to scroll progress

notes.zh: 传统法监听 scroll，在 rAF 里对每层执行 translateY(scrollTop * factor)， factor 小于 1 为慢层（背景 0.3、前景 1.2）； 现代法用 CSS scroll-driven animations（animation-timeline: scroll()）。 只动 transform 走合成层； 移动端与 prefers-reduced-motion 默认关闭。
notes.en: The classic way — listen to scroll and, inside rAF, apply translateY(scrollTop * factor) per layer, factor < 1 for slow layers (background 0.3, foreground 1.2); the modern way is CSS scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline: scroll()). Transform-only changes stay on the compositor; default off on mobile and under prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 给首屏添加视差滚动：背景图比前景慢速移动。
basic.en: Add parallax to the hero — the background image moves slower than the foreground.

design.zh: 首屏分三层：远景 0.3 倍速、中景 0.6 倍速、前景 1 倍速，滚动时速度差制造纵深；装饰层不影响可读性。
design.en: Split the hero into three layers — far 0.3x, mid 0.6x, near 1x — so the velocity gap creates depth while scrolling; decorative layers never harm legibility.

implementation.zh: 监听 scroll 容器，rAF 内对每层 style.transform = translateY(scrollTop * factor)；背景层加 will-change: transform。或用 CSS：animation-timeline: scroll() + keyframes 位移。reduced-motion 与触屏默认静态。
implementation.en: Listen to the scroll container, set style.transform = translateY(scrollTop * factor) per layer inside rAF; add will-change: transform to background layers. Or CSS: animation-timeline: scroll() + keyframed offsets. Static by default under reduced-motion and on touch.

agent.zh:
为项目首屏添加视差滚动效果。

先检查首屏结构与滚动容器，确认性能预算。
要求：
- 分层不同速率，只动 transform（合成层）
- rAF 节流或 CSS scroll-timeline 实现
- 不影响可读性与滚动性能（避免 scroll 监听重排）
- 移动端与 reduced-motion 默认关闭
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add parallax scrolling to the project's hero section.

Inspect the hero structure and scroll container first; confirm the performance budget.
Requirements:
- Layered speeds, transform-only (compositor)
- rAF throttling or CSS scroll-timeline
- No readability or scroll-performance regressions (no layout thrash)
- Off by default on mobile and under reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
